example_sentences_in_bangla: তার খণ্ডকপাল, সব কাজেই ব্যর্থ হয়ে যায়।
খণ্ডকপালিয়া লোকের সঙ্গে ব্যবসা করা উচিত নয়।
example_sentences_in_english: He has a broken forehead; everything he does turns to failure.
One should not do business with a person of bad luck.
history: This idiom originates from traditional Bengali beliefs where a 'broken forehead' symbolizes ill fate, possibly linked to ancient superstitions about physical marks indicating destiny.
note: The idiom reflects cultural views on predestined misfortune in Bengali folklore.
